description: Changes how a calendar's events read, for every team of a league or sport in it (leagues, sports, by code such as NFL or SOCCER) or for the whole calendar. The settings: games all, home or away (a team's games kept); names short or long (club names in titles); scoreRevealHours 0 (right away), 24, 48, 96 or -1 (never), the hours after the start before a result shows; alarmMinutes 0 (none), 30, 60 or 90 before the start. A team reads its own choice first (save_team_settings), then its league's, its sport's, the calendar's, then the standard (all games, short names, score right away, alarm 60 minutes). A league or sport named replaces what it had, one named with no choices is cleared, one left out is kept; the calendar's own four are replaced as sent. With applyToAllTeams, the teams' own choices of what the calendar states are cleared. Answers with every setting the calendar now holds.

applyToAllTeams.description: Also clears these choices from every team, so they all follow the calendar.

settings.description: The calendar's own four choices, each left out being the standard, and any of its sports' or leagues' by code ({"leagues": {"NFL": {"games": "home"}}}). A league or sport named replaces what it had, one named with no choices is cleared, and one left out keeps what it had.
